lines.text: Many learners say: Please wait me here.
Better: Please wait for me here.
Wait for me! Please wait for me here.

native.tip: 한국어 “나를 기다려요”는 목적어를 바로 쓰지만, 영어는 wait for를 써요. “Please wait for me”!
native.caption: “Please wait me here.”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어 “저를 기다려 주세요”는 목적어에 ‘를’만 붙여서 wait me라고 하기 쉬워요. 영어는 wait for를 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “Please wait for me here.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Wait needs for before the person. Say “Please wait for me here.”
en.caption: Do you say “Please wait me here” in English? 😅 After wait, you need for. “Please wait for me here” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
